project.title: aquascape-rock-v2-views
project.description: Source-matched supplementary artwork for the accepted operator-reviewed V2 individual. Follow the exact master identity and pixel-art drawing.
project.art_direction: Retain the supplied master artwork's naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters and restrained palette. No CGI or photographic noise.
project.session_goal: Source-matched supplementary views/parts for artwork-led 3D construction.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: rock_right
asset.description: View the EXACT same rock from its RIGHT END, orthographic camera level and perpendicular to the right end, no perspective, no three-quarter camera. The whole long object is foreshortened into a compact end elevation: depth about half master's width, height about half master's width. Retain the right scoop and slate mass; this is the end of the same object, not an alternative design. IMPORTANT: exact same individual rock and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: The exact same aquascape rock viewed from its RIGHT END: right scoop and slate mass retained, whole long object foreshortened into a compact end elevation.
Silhouette: Compact upright end mass, depth about half master width, height about half master width; all tips fully visible, clean unbroken edge.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Match master naturalistic detailed pixel art: coherent painted volume, crisp deliberate clusters, restrained palette, smooth deliberate shading; no CGI or photographic noise.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic camera level and perpendicular to the right end, no perspective, no three-quarter angle, no side-scroller angle.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Isolated on pure flat white #FFFFFF with generous white margin; no ground, no cast shadow, no border, no text.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No alternative rock design, no left/front view, no perspective tilt, no scenic background, no checkerboard or fake transparency, no labels, no multi-view sheet.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
